items.title: Official VoxType dictation
items.text: VoxType runs multilingual Whisper locally for Hebrew and English. Its model loads after your first shortcut and stays ready for reliable repeat dictation; audio stays on this computer.

items.title: A growing photo collection
items.text: Arctic’s photo wallpapers now replace the old stock backgrounds, while your own wallpaper choice stays yours.

items.title: Lighter everyday apps
items.text: Epiphany, Foot, PCManFM, XArchiver, Celluloid and FeatherPad keep the default desktop quick and focused.

items.title: Updates you can trust
items.text: Update checks report repository failures clearly, keep valid queued downloads, and retain signed stable repositories.

items.title: Desktop polish
items.text: The bar, lock screen, battery-full icon, wallpaper controls and app menus have received reliability and visual fixes.
